objective: A fifteen-model suite with only source-supported execution; large-model representative-layer results are labeled separately from end-to-end results

acceptance_policy.onnx_models: Strict operator audit pass, no unsupported grouped convolution, successful ONNXim completion, component validation pass, and exact controller RTL replay with zero safety violations
acceptance_policy.language_models: Full-model execution for OPT-125M validation; larger models are representative-layer characterization unless explicitly run with every architectural layer
acceptance_policy.reduced_inputs: Prompt/output reduction is a workload sensitivity parameter and must not be described as full production traffic
acceptance_policy.rejected_models: Never count a model whose meaningful operators become zero-work Dummy operations

rejected.mobilenet_v2: grouped/depthwise convolution is not source-supported by the current ConvWS path
rejected.densenet: BatchNormalization, Concat, Relu, and ReorderInput are unmodeled

suite_freeze_rule: Do not claim fifteen accepted models until fifteen entries independently satisfy their applicable acceptance policy
